method: Regulator-published lists read in a browser on November 1, 2026: OCM's Cannabis Laboratories page (permitted laboratory table with testing scope), OCM's Sampling Firms page (approved sampling firms) and OCM's SEE Cannabis Banking Directory. Each claim states only what the regulator lists. OCM states the banking directory is not an endorsement. Not legal or financial advice.

ocm-labs.limitations: OCM permitted-laboratory table (permit number, name, city, testing scope). Shows no page date. Turnaround, pricing and current capacity are not stated; footnoted scope marks (**) were not reviewed.

ocm-sampling.limitations: OCM approved sampling firm table (name, approval number, contact person, email or website). Shows no page date. Service areas and pricing are not stated.

ocm-banking.limitations: OCM SEE Cannabis Banking Directory. OCM states listing is for public convenience and is not an endorsement, support or recommendation. Account approval, fees and services are decided by each institution. Regions are New York economic development regions.
